professionalSummary.text: Candidate has three years of experience building survival and degradation models for maintenance intervals in the pump fleet analytics team.
professionalSummary.witness: Reliability analyst on the pump fleet analytics team of a pump service company for three years and seven months, building the survival and degradation models behind the maintenance intervals for two pump families.

experienceHighlights.text: Candidate has reviewed field failure data with service engineers under a documented data quality procedure.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Candidate has documented model limitations and interval boundaries for contract customers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Wrote the model limitation notes and the interval boundary statements sent to contract customers with each interval recommendation, and presented the recommendations to two contract customers with the head of fleet analytics.
